body:
## Pull request overview

Implements the P5 “Mobile User Experience” roadmap by applying mobile-first responsive Tailwind classes across key plugin views, core renderers, and the console app shell.

**Changes:**
- Updated multiple plugin view layouts (Timeline, Map, Kanban, Gantt, Detail, Dashboard, Charts) to be responsive via Tailwind breakpoints.
- Improved core primitives (Form actions, DataTable pagination) for better mobile ergonomics.
- Updated console app infrastructure (viewport meta tags, Tailwind source scanning, mobile CSS utilities) and marked roadmap items complete.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 14 out of 14 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugin-timeline/src/renderer.tsx | Mobile-friendly header padding/text sizing in Gantt timeline variant. |
| packages/plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.tsx | Replaces fixed map container height with responsive Tailwind heights; adjusts popup min width. |
| packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanImpl.tsx | Responsive Kanban card padding/typography; truncation and touch-related classes. |
| packages/plugin-gantt/src/GanttView.tsx | Responsive toolbar layout, smaller typography on mobile, hides start/end columns on mobile, adds iOS momentum scrolling. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx | Makes action area full-width on mobile; tightens section spacing on small screens. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx | Mobile-first grid column stacking and responsive content padding. |
| packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardRenderer.tsx | Responsive chart widget heights and header padding/typography adjustments. |
| packages/plugin-charts/src/ChartRenderer.tsx | Responsive skeleton heights for Suspense fallbacks. |
| packages/plugin-charts/src/ChartImpl.tsx | Responsive container padding and tighter chart margins for small screens. |
| packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx | Stacks action buttons on mobile and makes them full-width below `sm`. |
| packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx | Smaller pagination text on mobile; hides total count below `sm`. |
| apps/console/src/index.css | Adds Tailwind @source for mobile package; adds mobile CSS rules/utilities (iOS zoom prevention, dvh, safe-area). |
| apps/console/index.html | Updates viewport meta + adds mobile web-app capability meta tags. |
| ROADMAP.md | Marks P5 roadmap items as completed. |
</details>



<details>
<summary>Comments suppressed due to low confidence (1)</summary>

**packages/plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.tsx:425**
* The wrapper div was updated to use Tailwind sizing, but the `Map` component still relies on an inline `style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }}` to fill the container. If `react-map-gl/maplibre` supports `className`, prefer `className="w-full h-full"` (or equivalent) and drop the inline style to keep styling consistent and avoid mixing Tailwind with inline styles.
```
      <div className="relative border rounded-lg overflow-hidden bg-muted h-[300px] sm:h-[400px] md:h-[500px] lg:h-[600px] w-full">
         <Map
            initialViewState={initialViewState}
            style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }}
            mapStyle="https://demotiles.maplibre.org/style.json"
```
</details>

The iOS zoom-prevention rule applies `font-size: 16px` to **all** `input, select, textarea` on small screens. This can unintentionally change sizing for controls that aren’t text-entry (e.g., checkbox/radio/range) and may override intentionally smaller control typography in dense UIs. Consider scoping this to text-like inputs (and possibly `textarea/select`) instead of all input types.
```suggestion
    input[type="text"],
    input[type="email"],
    input[type="password"],
    input[type="search"],
    input[type="tel"],
    input[type="url"],
    input[type="number"],
    textarea,
    select {
```

`.h-dvh` and `.safe-area-inset` are being defined inside `@layer base`. Since these are utility-style classes (not element base styles), consider moving them into `@layer utilities` to keep Tailwind layering/specificity predictable and make it clearer these are reusable utilities. Also, Tailwind v4 already provides a `h-dvh` utility, so having a custom `.h-dvh` here may be redundant/confusing.

In the Gantt variant, the header row label now uses smaller padding/text (`px-2`, `text-xs`), but the body row labels still come from `TimelineGanttLabel` which defaults to `px-4 py-2 text-sm` (see `TimelineGanttLabel` in `packages/plugin-timeline/src/index.tsx`). This will likely make the “Items” header misalign visually with the row labels on mobile. Consider passing a responsive `className` to `TimelineGanttLabel` here (or keeping the header padding consistent with the label component) so header/body label columns match.
```suggestion
            <TimelineGanttRowLabels className="flex items-center px-4 py-2">
              <span className="font-semibold text-sm">
```
